exposure: Consumption of carbohydrate-rich fluids prior to elective caesarean surgery
Consumption of distilled water prior to elective caesarean surgery
cohort: One hundred parturients undergoing elective caesarean delivery under spinal anaesthesia were randomly assigned to either a carbohydrate preloading group or a control group.
finding: Carbohydrate-rich beverages did not affect ObsQoR-10 scores, postoperative tramadol consumption, or VAS scores, but significantly increased the sensation of breast fullness.
mod_finding: Carbohydrate-rich beverages increased the sensation of breast fullness, which may promote breastfeeding among mothers recovering from caesarean sections.
